_note: The settings surface for the UNIFIED DecisionTemplate schema (slug decision-template), appended onto src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). This fragment exists because the model refactor landed without one: unified-decision-templates (archived 2026-08-19) folded ProcessTemplate and VveDecisionTemplate into DecisionTemplate and marked both active:false, but shipped no page, so the schema that actually carries the templates had NO surface at all while the gear still listed the two retired copies. Measured on a live instance 2026-08-31: decision-template 28 objects and no page; vve-decision-template 6 and modelreglement-preset 3, both superseded, both on the gear. Schema ref BY SLUG (decision-template), never PascalCase.

pages.title: Decision templates
pages._note: Every decision template, whichever kind of organisation it belongs to. `context` is the discriminator the VvE-only page used to stand in for: association, corporate, legislative, operations, citizen. Built-ins are read-only-but-duplicable (server-side guard).

config._note: Sorted by name, not @self.created: an operator picking a template reads a list of names, and creation order is meaningless to them.

pages.title: Decision template
pages._note: Template content leads: name, context, category, proposed text, the voting and quorum rules a decision instantiated from it inherits, and the regulation it cites. Audit trail in a sidebar tab.
